                        .svn,CVS,.bzr,.hg,.git,__pycache__,.tox,.eggs,*.egg)
  --incremental         enable incremental analysis using cached results
  --no-incremental      disable incremental analysis (default)
  --cache-dir CACHE_DIR
                        directory to use for the incremental analysis cache
  --cache-size-limit CACHE_SIZE_LIMIT
                        maximum size of the cache file in bytes
  --clear-cache         clear the cache directory and exit
  --cache-summary       print the number of files in the cache and exit
  --force-rescan        bypass cache lookups but still store results (requires
                        --incremental)
  --warm-cache          pre-populate the cache without reporting issues
  --export-cache FILE   export the cache to a JSON file and exit
  --import-cache FILE   import and merge a cache from a JSON file and exit
  --list-cached-files   list files in the cache, one per line, and exit
  --prune-cache DAYS    remove cached entries older than DAYS days and exit
  --cache-stats         print cache statistics and exit
